summary: Executed backend+frontend regression on public preview for survival expansion. New v2 backend suite passed for pickup expiry worker, footpath enforcement, survival/collision/services/recovery logic, and serialization. Legacy backend tests have stale assumptions and produced 5 non-product failures. Frontend mobile checks validated load, HUD status instructions, phone online toggle/order acceptance, pickup interaction (in retry), and 7-tab single-row layout at 390x844 and 360x740; full scripted deliver+milestone flow remained flaky due movement/actionability timing.

minor.issue: Existing test_delivery_game_api.py still uses old non-footpath coordinates and assumes immediate back-to-back offer availability; caused 5 failing tests despite v2 behavior working.

integration_issues.issue: Movement-control automation is timing-sensitive; one full E2E run failed before pickup actionability while retry confirmed pickup success. Needs deterministic UI-state gating around rider position/arrival.

action_items: Update/replace legacy backend file test_delivery_game_api.py to v2 rules (footpath-only interactions, cooldown-aware order generation, garage-only purchases).
Add deterministic frontend testIDs/state for pickup/dropoff arrival readiness to reduce movement-action timing flakes in Playwright.
Re-run full UI scripted flow for delivery reward modal and milestone claim after deterministic arrival gate is added.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking backend logic defects found in tested v2 endpoints; failures were primarily stale test expectations.
Expo supervisor err log shows intermittent React Native DevTools install/start noise in container (non-blocking to web gameplay).

success_rate.backend: 81% (22/27 across full suite; 100% in new v2 suite)
success_rate.frontend: 70% (core mobile flows verified; one full E2E delivery script remained flaky)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated anonymous sessions via POST /api/sessions. For fixture setup, modified only those isolated profile/order docs by exact UUID in test_database Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_survival_expansion_v2.py as primary regression for expansion behavior. Legacy /app/backend/tests/test_delivery_game_api.py currently mixes pre-v2 assumptions. For UI, pickup can be validated with axis movement to y~600 then x~352; full delivery automation still needs stronger readiness gating.
rca_of_issue: Backend failures came from outdated test logic (old coordinates and no cooldown handling), not confirmed API regressions in new expansion routes. Frontend E2E instability is tied to fine-grained movement/action timing around arrival detection rather than persistent API errors.
